blocks.text: BANGKOK, Thailand – Nine people were injured, three of them critically, after a powerful explosion ripped through an oil facility in Bangkok on Thursday, Thai authorities said. The blast was so strong that it rattled doors several kilometres away, according to AFP reporters, who saw a column of flames above the site followed by thick black smoke. Thailand’s Energy minister Akanat Promphan, visiting the scene, said the blast sparked concern as the sprawling Phra Khanong site in eastern Bangkok was “also a residential area”.
